title: The Green Bus Past the Meadow
synopsis: Amy and Wendy discover the green bus stop west of Far Meadow and ride with Grandma May and Aunt Kay to the next town’s Market Street.
continuity_state: Before: Season eight ends with six friends settled at home, quiet Story House door with soft latch click, three unchanged shelf collections, and Amy’s yellow map ending west at Far Meadow. After: Amy and Wendy, accompanied by Grandma May and Aunt Kay, first visit a green bus stop along the paved road west of Far Meadow and ride to Market Street in the next town; they see the bakery, painted-window library, awning clock, pigeon bench and flower stall. Amy’s existing yellow map is unchanged: it ends at Far Meadow. They return home that day; no ticket or other item is kept.

related_resources.reason: NAEYC open-ended question guidance gives background for talking with children about observations; the map running out is invented fiction.
The AAP report discusses play and everyday exploration with adults, but does not study this imaginary bus trip or the effectiveness of a narrated version.
